facts.why: Sources opened name the venue Barnum's American Museum, later renamed Barnum's Circus. 'Museum of Wonders' was not found.

vibe.verdict: Good dark theatre look with the right acts named, but the food is generic fair food and it does not use the songs or the big set pieces.
missing: The circus renamed Barnum's Circus (after the protests)
